title: Asmara Highland Road Race
tagline: Pace the climb, hide in the group and attack when it counts.
description: A stage race over the Eritrean highland roads. Manage three riders against five rival teams: sit in the slipstream, pull, save your reserve and launch your attack on the hairpin climbs. Six stages, a time trial, and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap one of your three riders, then choose EASE, SIT IN, PUSH or ATTACK.
Sit behind another rider to save about a third of the effort on the flat.
Hard efforts spend a reserve; at zero your rider cracks and slows down.
Spend the reserve where it pays most: on the steep climbs and in the finale.
Think shows the best orders found by trying the next minute several ways.
